title: Smart Contracts for Trustless Sampling of Correlated Equilibria
venue: International Joint Conference on Artificial Intelligence
abstract: A correlated equilibrium gives each player a private recommendation drawn from a joint distribution. Implementing it requires sampling the recommendations without revealing the other player’s component. The paper gives two smart-contract protocols, based on oblivious transfer and zero-knowledge succinct proofs, with privacy and incentive analysis. The construction addresses two-player games; extending it to more players requires additional techniques.
summary: Replaces the trusted mediator for sampling a two-player correlated equilibrium with cryptographic smart-contract protocols and incentives for participation.
